checks.name: actual owner API exposes only checked free windows, current revision and privacy-safe provenance
manual-only preview uses existing blocks, field windows and capacity with zero Google/model requests
owner preview rejects anonymous, wrong owner, revoked session and foreign origin before provider work
strict date/range/shape and stale rules fail without a Calendar read
move preview excludes only its own reservation and exact Google copy, retaining external conflicts
foreign/stale/cancelled visit exclusion is rejected rather than hiding someone else’s occupied time
provider failure or incomplete pagination is unavailable/retry, never an empty free schedule
availability preview shares short cache but authoritative save sees a later Google conflict
rules, session and tenant changes during Google response cannot return stale owner availability
ordinary actual workspace 1440px owner finds free times, preserves customer fields and saves one visit
